design: A fixed grant, a £310,000 gap, a promise of no council tax rise and one lifeline route make a hard bind: filling the gap breaks the tax promise, charging more breaks the cap, and cutting the 14 strands four villages. Every route crosses a red line.
tests_hint: Limits: no village loses its only bus; no council tax rise; fare never above £2. Tests: say who pays the £310,000 and how; name a date; say who to call if the bus fails; keep evening or Sunday buses.
angles: Charge more on the market town leg
Ask the firm to run at a loss for a year
